item.title: Child of Chinese illegal immigrants charged with planting explosive at US military base
item.summary: DHS revealed that a suspect who fled to China after allegedly planting a deadly explosive device at an important military base is the child of two Chinese illegal immigrants.

item.title: Dogs were 'loyal companions to Ice Age hunters' far earlier than believed, study finds
item.summary: Pushing back the domestication timeline by 5,000 years via ancient DNA, a new study suggests that dogs lived with humans 14,000 to 16,000 years ago.

item.title: 'Last Man Standing' alum Nancy Travis warns Americans 'feel more alone than ever'
item.summary: Nancy Travis discusses her role in Lifetime's "Rescued by Faith: The Connie and Larry Van Oosten Story," reflecting on America's growing sense of isolation and the power of faith and community in overcoming adversity.

item.title: Alcatraz could reopen as a 'state-of-the-art secure prison' under Trump's $152M budget request
item.summary: The White House is seeking $152 million to reopen Alcatraz, closed since 1963, as a state-of-the-art secure facility for federal inmates.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: Kamala Harris backs radical plan to block Trump SCOTUS picks
item.summary: Former Vice President Kamala Harris is rallying Democratic donors to oppose potential Trump Supreme Court nominees through the group Demand Justice.

item.title: UConn's undefeated season crumbles as South Carolina gets sweet revenge against reigning champs
item.summary: South Carolina ended UConn's 54-game winning streak with a 62-48 Final Four victory, outscoring the Huskies by 16 points in the final 20 minutes.

item.title: 'The Super Mario Galaxy Movie' Review: A nostalgic blast for Nintendo fans
item.summary: Fox News Digital reviews Universal and Illumination's "The Super Mario Galaxy Movie" starring Chris Pratt, Jack Black, Anya Taylor-Joy, Charlie Day and Brie Larson.

item.title: Johnny Carson's strict character rule kept Pee-Wee Herman from appearing on 'Tonight Show': book
item.summary: According to Mark Malkoff's book, Carson refused "Tonight Show" guests who appeared in character, which included Paul Reubens as Pee-Wee Herman.

item.title: Georgia teachers union boss blames school choice for public schools being 'grossly underfunded'
item.summary: Georgia teachers union leader slams school choice, blaming "disinformation" for public school enrollment drops and a recent wave of Atlanta school closures.

item.title: Education Secretary Linda McMahon accuses critics of having ‘Trump Derangement Syndrome’
item.summary: Linda McMahon discusses President Donald Trump's directive to fire herself by dismantling the Department of Education, calling out critics driven by "Trump Derangement Syndrome."
